“弟子不敢。”
唐绝吓了一跳，赶紧说道：“弟子只是说，若是陛下真的要对我们唐门开刀的话，我唐门总不能任人宰割！”
“那可是我唐门数万弟子的性命！”
“放心好了。”
唐世元摇摇头：“我们这位陛下，轻易不会对我们唐门开刀的。”
“那老祖，千命鬼莲怎么办？”唐绝说道：“要不我现在派人到白云城那边寻找一下，找到人，将千命鬼莲给拿回来，那毕竟是我们唐门的镇族之宝。”
“现在去？”
唐世元冷哼一声：“还嫌不够把把柄送到神阙皇都去？”
听到这话，唐绝仔细一想也是，赵千秋刚死，这个时候就将千命鬼莲给找回唐门，若是说唐门和那个懂得大天象诀的人没有半点关系，怕是这次真的没人相信了。
那千命鬼莲暂时只能在那个神秘人的手中了。
太玄圣地。
太玄圣主那天晚上回来之后就继续闭关恢复伤势，他并没有把这件事情告诉任何人。
对于李寒舟的身份，太玄圣主并不清楚。
他可懒得招惹这么一个来历不明的强敌。
并且目前看来，对方对太玄圣地没有什么敌意，应该就是一个隐居的强者，东延州都没有听说过这号人物的。
“圣主。”
这个时候，外面传来了一道声音，乃是太玄圣地大长老的声音。
“何事？”
太玄圣主问道。

“启禀圣主，岳山宗，赵家，还有霸刀门，之前递交了战帖，要联手上长生观切磋，这次是希望我们太玄圣地能出一个人当做仲裁，所以想请圣主出山。”大长老在外面说。
“只是弟子之间的切磋，这样的小事随便找个人去不就行了，这种事也要我亲自去？”太玄圣主感觉有点莫名其妙。
“圣主，这件事我觉得还是圣主带着人去比较好，上次的弟子考核，我们太玄圣地的用意都被他们看的清清楚楚，另外他们三家在上次考核中的损失可以说是……有点大吧，圣主亲自去，能让他们感觉到我们太玄圣地是有诚意的。”
“另外还有最重要的一点，那般若斧在长生观呢，圣主亲临，那长生观就明白怎么回事了，会偷偷的将般若斧还给我们的。”
“那般若斧是圣主您从神牛山拼了命抢回来的，是为了陆天行，总不能让那长生观的弟子莫名其妙的就给拿走了。”
太玄圣主听了听，觉得也有道理。
那既然如此，自己就走一趟吧。
“那长生观在哪里？”太玄圣地麾下的势力太多，太玄圣主根本记不得有这么个小地方。
“在白云城附近，是一个只有几个人的小道观，连个三流宗门都算不上，这次他们长生观的弟子凭借着古怪的灵宝才获得了第一名，我也调查过了，那长生观的观主早就失踪了，如今整个长生观只有几个弟子，还有他们的废物师叔，般若斧落到这样的地方，我们太玄圣地必须要拿回来才行。”
大长老给太玄圣主介绍着。
“道门……”太玄圣主喃喃地说道：“那倒是正常。”
毕竟道门没落数百年了，如今存在着的道门凤毛麟角一般。
即便是存在也没有几个弟子。
太玄圣主不禁想到了李寒舟，貌似也是道门的高手，但应该和长生观没有关系。
李寒舟从神机商会中回来，买了不少炼制的材料，另外还安排了神机商会明日就来到长生观着手准备翻修长生观的事情。
毕竟马上其他宗门的人要来了，看到长生观破破烂烂的，岂不是让人笑话？
几天的时间，能翻修成什么样就什么样吧。

"Disciples don't dare."
Tang Jue was startled and said quickly: "My disciple is just saying that if His Majesty really wants to attack our Tang Sect, we, the Tang Sect, cannot be at the mercy of others!"
"That's the lives of tens of thousands of my Tang Sect disciples!"
"Don't worry."
Tang Shiyuan shook his head: "Our Majesty will not attack our Tang Clan easily."
"Ancestor, what should I do with the Thousand-Life Ghost Lotus?" Tang Jue said: "How about I send people to Baiyun City to search for it now, find the person, and bring back the Thousand-Life Ghost Lotus. After all, it is the family treasure of our Tang Sect."
"Go now?"
Tang Shiyuan snorted coldly: "Isn't that enough to send the clue to the Shenque Emperor's Capital?"
After hearing this, Tang Jue thought about it carefully. Zhao Qianqiu had just died and the Thousand-Life Ghost Lotus was brought back to the Tang Clan. If it was said that the Tang Clan had nothing to do with the person who knew the Great Celestial Elephant Technique, no one would believe it this time.
The Thousand-Life Ghost Lotus can only be in the hands of that mysterious man for the time being.
Taixuan Holy Land.
After Saint Master Taixuan came back that night, he continued to retreat to recover from his injuries. He did not tell anyone about it.
Saint Master Taixuan is not clear about Li Hanzhou's identity.
He was too lazy to provoke such a powerful enemy of unknown origin.
And at present, it seems that the other party has no hostility towards Taixuan Holy Land. He should be a reclusive strong man. Even Dongyan Prefecture has never heard of this person.
"Holy Lord."
At this time, a voice came from outside. It was the voice of the Great Elder of Taixuan Holy Land.
"What's the matter?"
Saint Lord Taixuan asked.
"The Holy Lord Qi, the Yueshan Sect, the Zhao family, and the Ba Dao Sect have previously submitted a battle invitation to join forces with the Temple of Immortality to spar. This time, we hope that one of our Taixuan Holy Land can be the referee, so we want to invite the Holy Lord to come out." The Great Elder said outside.
"It's just a discussion between disciples. Can't you just find someone to handle such a trivial matter? Do you need me to handle such a matter in person?" Saint Master Taixuan felt a little confused.
"Holy Master, I think it would be better for the Holy Master to take someone with him on this matter. In the last disciple assessment, our Taixuan Holy Land's intentions were clearly seen by them. In addition, the losses suffered by the three families in the last assessment can be said to be... a bit big. The Holy Master goes in person to make them feel that our Taixuan Holy Land is sincere."
"The most important point is that the Prajna Ax is in the Changsheng Temple. If the Holy Lord comes in person, the Changsheng Temple will understand what is going on and will secretly return the Prajna Ax to us."
"The Prajna Ax was snatched back from Shenniu Mountain by the Holy Master with all your life. It was for Lu Tianxing. We can't let the disciple of Immortality Temple take it away inexplicably."
After hearing this, Saint Taixuan felt that it made sense.
In that case, go and take a trip yourself.
"Where is the Temple of Immortality?" Taixuan Holy Land has too many forces under its command, and Taixuan Holy Land cannot even remember the existence of such a small place.
"Near Baiyun City, there is a small Taoist temple with only a few people. It is not even a third-rate sect. This time, their disciples of the Immortal Temple won the first place with their weird spiritual treasures. I have also investigated and found that the temple owner of the Immortal Temple has disappeared long ago. Now there are only a few disciples in the entire Immortal Temple, and their useless uncle. If the Prajna Ax falls in such a place, we in Taixuan Holy Land must get it back."
The Great Elder introduced the Lord Taixuan.
"Taomen..." Saint Master Taixuan murmured, "That's normal."
After all, Taoism has been in decline for hundreds of years, and there are only a handful of Taoisms that exist today.
Even if it exists, there are only a few disciples.
Saint Master Taixuan couldn't help but think of Li Hanzhou, who seemed to be a master of the Taoist sect, but he probably had nothing to do with the concept of immortality.
Li Hanzhou came back from the Shenji Chamber of Commerce and bought a lot of refining materials. He also arranged for the Shenji Chamber of Commerce to come to the Changsheng Temple tomorrow to prepare for the renovation of the Changsheng Temple.
completePeople from other sects are coming soon. Wouldn't it be a joke to see the Changsheng Temple in tatters?
In a few days, you can renovate it into whatever you can.
